税收变化对于养老金领取者来说是个好消息。

ex: to be in a pensive mood

ex: He gazed pensively out of the window.
他沉思地凝视着窗外。

zh: 感情抑郁的；难以抒怀的
en: that cannot be expressed or released
ex: pent-up frustration/energy
郁积的挫折感；被抑制的精力

ex: pentagon
五边形

en: a flat shape with five straight sides and five angles

美国国防部发言人
